paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2017 - SpatialRecruiter Maximizing Sensing Coverage in Selecting Workers for Spatial Crowdsourcing
title: SpatialRecruiter: Maximizing Sensing Coverage in Selecting Workers for Spatial Crowdsourcing
motivation: 招募两套工人分别完成查询任务和感知任务效率低
problem_framing: 联合最大化查询任务完成率与感知覆盖面积
key_insight: 利用工人到查询任务目的地之间的轨迹同时覆盖感知区域
method_signature: 角度估计和熵估计函数+贪心选择
evaluation_criteria: 覆盖面积、覆盖效率、完成率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 随k增大性能下降,距离度量对覆盖影响不大
evidence_for_taste: recruiting two sets of workers is not efficient
makes travelling trajectories of workers valuable
designed to accommodate the unknown mobility of workers
coverage estimation functions were designed to accommodate the unknown mobility
thinking_moves: 找到两个范式之间的关键连接点
在无先验知识情况下设计覆盖估计函数
用集合论证明覆盖函数是次模的
从几何直觉出发转化为角度区间覆盖问题
用信息熵度量工人分布多样性
